Static-analysis results (linearised DC path analysis through the conv stacks incl. GroupNorm mean-removal and SiLU slope ~0.5, weight-norm bookkeeping, and head.2·head.0 products; no probes were usable because bite names are unknown).

1. Input channel with largest effect on completion: **channel 3 (physics prior)**, with a **negative** sign (raising the prior toward 0, i.e. removing the predicted cut, lowers predicted completion; a more negative/larger prior cut raises it). Linearised d(completion)/d(ch) ≈ ch3 −0.0061, ch1 +0.0032, ch5 −0.0023 (cohesion ↑ → completion ↓), ch6 −0.0011, ch0/ch2/ch4 ≈ 0. Channel 3 also has the largest e1.0 weight norm (1.44 vs ≤1.31 for the others) and the largest propagated gain in every layer. Runner-up: channel 1 (swept envelope), positive sign. Confidence 0.4 (sign 0.35).

2. Soil channels (4–6) are used mostly in the **encoder**. e2.0 draws on the e1 block outputs ~2.4× more strongly than d1.0 draws on the e1 skip (soil-weighted use 6.6 vs 2.8; per-channel L2 0.87 vs 0.35), and soil information is needed for the global stall/force head and for slump geometry decided at e3/e4. The three e1.0 filters most tied to the soil planes (largest effective 3x3-summed soil weights, both absolute and as a fraction of the filter): **17** (φ −0.53, c −0.48), **24** (c −0.44, ρ −0.31, φ +0.19), **28** (c +0.50, ρ −0.30). Next: 29, 30, 9, 0. Confidence 0.55 (encoder 0.55, filters 0.6).

3. e4 channels most plausibly encoding "the bucket will stall" (most negative effective weight on the completion output through head.0→head.2, combining mean- and max-pool halves, most also raising the peak-force output): **82, 98, 160, 61, 245** (then 171, 95, 17, 241, 55). 82/98/160 both lower completion and raise actuator demand, which is the stall signature. Confidence 0.4.

4. d1/out channels (DC sensitivity of d1 output to the cut signature: ch2 0, ch1 and ch3 negative, mainly via the e1 skip):
 - write mainly inside the cut (ch2 = 0): **29, 23, 17, 16, 12, 24** (and 2, 0). Of these 17 and 23 have negative out weights (−0.129, −0.047 → deepen the cut), 29/24/12 have positive out weights (+0.10/+0.135/+0.063 → fill/limit the cut).
 - write mainly outside the cut (ch2 = 1, slump/far cells): **28, 19, 3, 14, 18, 22** (and 27, 9); 19 and 27 have the large negative out weights (−0.119, −0.150 → slump lowering outside the cut), 28/3/18 positive (heaping).
 Confidence 0.3.
